title: Monotonicity of the sharing degree bound
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $d,e\in\mathbb N$ with $d\le e$, and let $x\in F$ and $f$ be a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$. If $f$ shares $x$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$, then it shares $x$ using a polynomial of degree at most $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A share function $f$ on nonzero elements of $F$
